note: Malaysia: every performance by a foreign artiste goes through the one-stop centre for foreign film production and foreign artiste performances (PUSPAL) of the Ministry of Communications, and the artiste enters only once the Professional Visit Pass (PLIK) and visa with reference are approved (Immigration Department of Malaysia). No days of performing without them are named.

sources.title: Immigration Department of Malaysia, Professional Visit Pass: PUSPAL
sources.said: All applications for filming by Foreign Film Production Companies and performances by Foreign Artistes must go through a one-stop application center managed by the responsible Ministry. ... Applicants are only allowed to enter Malaysia after obtaining approval for their Professional Visit Pass (PLIK) and Visa with Reference (VDR).
